correctness.rationale: The ordered sequence of non-a letters is unchanged by any deletion. Scanning the residual uniquely gives all retained a-gap counts even when separators have repeated letters; hence X_k is the coefficient of the product of finite geometric sums, and Y is the product of (c_i+1). Each weak composition has the same multiplicity (q-1)^b. Splitting each c_i into deleted and residual parts, of respective totals k and m-k, verifies the mean by two separate stars-and-bars counts. For the second moment, grouping two deletion counts by their minimum and signed difference gives the single-gap kernel (1-x²uv)/((1-x)(1-xu)(1-xv)(1-xuv)), equivalent to the stated H. Extracting the total m from its r-th power implements the conditioning, not independence of gaps. At u=v=1 this becomes (1+x)/(1-x)^3; the one-mark kernel at u=1 is (1-x)^-2. The smoothing difference is exactly the interval of monomials from B+1 to A-1, strictly positive at z=1, so balancing terminates with the stated simultaneous equality class and multiplicity. At b=m this gives 2^m and m+1 maximizing compositions. Stirling's formula for the ratio of the binomials, including the factor (3m+1)/(2m+1) from shifting the numerator, confirms the two asymptotics and prefactors.
residual_risks: The sample scripts are corroboration, not proof. The printed 21648 counter weights each (k,l) cell by the number of compositions; there are 816 distinct parameter/cell combinations in the script, not 21648 distinct coefficients.
The law conditions on one distinguished count, not a complete q-letter composition; it does not cover nonmonochromatic deletions.

value.rationale: Monochromatic complement deletion isolates a natural source of collisions. The cross moments quantify how counts at different deletion depths vary together in a fixed-count experiment, while the sharp 27/32 comparison quantifies a consequential discrepancy between mean residual ambiguity and worst-case ambiguity. The whole conditional profile, not elementary smoothing or stars and bars in isolation, is the useful invariant.
residual_risks: Neither a typical-value estimate nor a channel-capacity conclusion follows from the mean-to-optimum comparison.
